func codingagent.CreateFindTool func(string, ...codingagent.FindToolOptions) (agent.ErasedAgentTool, error)

func codingagent.CreateFindToolDefinition func(string, ...codingagent.FindToolOptions) (codingagent.ToolDefinition, error)

func codingagent.CreateLsTool func(string, ...codingagent.LsToolOptions) (agent.ErasedAgentTool, error)

func codingagent.CreateLsToolDefinition func(string, ...codingagent.LsToolOptions) (codingagent.ToolDefinition, error)

type codingagent.FindToolOptions struct
fields:
- Operations codingagent.FindOperations tag=""

type codingagent.FindToolInput struct
fields:
- Pattern string tag=""
- Path string tag=""
- Limit *int tag=""

type codingagent.FindToolDetails struct
fields:
- Truncation *agent.TruncationResult tag=""
- ResultLimitReached *int tag=""

type codingagent.FindGlobOptions struct
fields:
- Ignore []string tag=""
- Limit int tag=""

type codingagent.FindOperations interface
  Exists func(context.Context, string) (bool, error)
  Glob func(context.Context, string, string, codingagent.FindGlobOptions) ([]string, error)

type codingagent.LsToolOptions struct
fields:
- Operations codingagent.LsOperations tag=""

type codingagent.LsToolInput struct
fields:
- Path string tag=""
- Limit *int tag=""

type codingagent.LsToolDetails struct
fields:
- Truncation *agent.TruncationResult tag=""
- EntryLimitReached *int tag=""

type codingagent.LsOperations interface
  Exists func(context.Context, string) (bool, error)
  Readdir func(context.Context, string) ([]string, error)
  Stat func(context.Context, string) (codingagent.LsFileInfo, error)

type codingagent.LsFileInfo interface
  IsDirectory func() bool
